pros: Fin resolves a large share of chat without an agent touching it
Handover passes transcript, summary and customer attributes to the human
Fin Tasks call your APIs to complete work, not only answer questions
Resolution based billing means you pay less when the AI underperforms
Separate resolution rate and CSAT reporting for AI versus human conversations
cons: Seat prices sit at the top of the category before Fin charges
Fin resolution fees make monthly bills hard to forecast
Chat first; voice and complex multi department ticketing are thin
Heavy for small teams that only want a website bot
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Intercom if you want an AI agent resolving most of your chat volume for a SaaS product with logged-in users.

pros: Every channel including phone and SMS lands as one ticket
Triggers and automations encode nearly any routing or escalation policy
Multi brand, skills based routing and custom forms are native
Zendesk Talk gives IVR, recording and callbacks in the same workspace
Marketplace of over a thousand integrations extends the core
cons: AI copilot and autonomous agents are paid add-ons on top of seats
Annual contracts and negotiation are expected, awkward for small companies
Needs a dedicated admin to keep triggers and views from tangling
Autonomous agent trails Fin on chat heavy conversational quality
verdict_line: Pick Zendesk if you run several channels including phone across multiple teams and need mature ticketing with encoded escalation rules.

pros: Free plan gives a small team email ticketing and a knowledge base
Paid tiers with SLAs and reporting cost far less than enterprise desks
Mailbox, articles and basic automations set up in an afternoon
Freddy Copilot summaries and rephrasing shave minutes off every ticket
Automation rules use plain language menus, no dedicated admin needed
cons: Custom reports and deeper analytics only arrive on higher plans
Live chat is Freshchat, a separate product with its own pricing
Freddy AI Agent handles simple questions but not multi step actions
Automation engine hits edges with many brands and heavy custom workflows
verdict_line: Pick Freshdesk if a small team needs a real help desk with SLAs and automations at a fraction of enterprise seat prices.

pros: Lyro crawls your FAQ and answers order questions the same day
Shopify order and cart details show inside the conversation
Lyro declines to answer when sources do not match, limiting invented policies
Visual flow builder triggers on exit intent, cart value or page visits
Free plan is enough to run a very small site for months
cons: No SLAs, ticket lifecycle or serious assignment rules; not a help desk
Lyro answers from documents but cannot take actions in backend systems
Lyro conversation limits run out fast on busy sites and add-ons surprise
Stacked rule based flows produce overlapping pop-ups without pruning
key_features: Customer and order data in view
verdict_line: Pick Tidio if you run an online store and want live chat plus a Lyro bot working on Shopify within minutes, without a support team.
